How tests/fixtures/uds/rainfall_interface.rain was produced.

It is a SWMM5-RAIN file written by SWMM 5 itself, kept so this engine's
reader is checked against the format rather than against its own writer
(§14.8.3). Two gages, because a single-gage file cannot catch a mistake in
the byte offsets that address each gage's readings.

Two rain records in the predecessor's standard station format:

    rain2.dat                       rainB.dat
    STA01  2020  1  1  0   0   0.10     STAB  2020  1  1  0   0   0.40
    STA01  2020  1  1  0   15  0.25     STAB  2020  1  1  0   15  0.20
    STA01  2020  1  1  0   30  0.00     STAB  2020  1  1  0   30  0.30
    STA01  2020  1  1  0   45  0.05

and a model reading both, run with SAVE RAINFALL:

    [RAINGAGES]
    G1  VOLUME  0:15  1.0  FILE  "rain2.dat"  STA01  IN
    G2  VOLUME  0:15  1.0  FILE  "rainB.dat"  STAB   IN

The result is 2172 bytes: a 14-byte preamble, two 1037-byte gage headers,
then STA01's four readings and STAB's three.
